destinations.What_Goes_Here: All normalized entities, facts, identifiers, time scopes and provenance
destinations.Visibility_Default: Rafts and Rivers internal; tenant-scoped data rules apply
destinations.Eligibility_Rule: Always eligible for normalized fact storage if extraction succeeds
destinations.Safety_or_Quality_Control: No public release; no unsupported inference

destinations.Visibility_Default: Rafts and Rivers internal; university may see only approved released views
destinations.Eligibility_Rule: Only mappings supported by current official source or explicitly labelled candidate
destinations.Safety_or_Quality_Control: Version-lock exact agency fields; candidate crosswalks not submission-ready

destinations.What_Goes_Here: Evidence bundle per requirement; missing/available/verified status
destinations.Visibility_Default: Rafts and Rivers internal by default; release is controlled
destinations.Eligibility_Rule: Use mapped evidence and visible document names/package names
destinations.Safety_or_Quality_Control: No automatic claim of evidence sufficiency

destinations.What_Goes_Here: Agency-ready values/tables/files for a specific cycle/version
destinations.Visibility_Default: Rafts and Rivers internal by default; released deliverables only to university
destinations.Eligibility_Rule: Verified data, reconciliation, approved mapping, correct reporting period
destinations.Safety_or_Quality_Control: No direct submission without authorization and version check

destinations.What_Goes_Here: Institution, units, programmes, faculty/staff, contacts, research, infrastructure, placements
destinations.Visibility_Default: University can view/download its own permitted institutional outputs; Rafts and Rivers full workspace

destinations.What_Goes_Here: Meeting, agenda, attendance, minutes, decisions, actions, ATR, implementation evidence
destinations.Visibility_Default: University can view/download own permitted records; sensitive committee items role-restricted
destinations.Eligibility_Rule: Meeting linkage and approval state required
destinations.Safety_or_Quality_Control: Draft vs approved status must be visible

destinations.What_Goes_Here: Website articles, news, press releases, social posts/reels, LinkedIn articles, X, Instagram, Facebook
destinations.Visibility_Default: University can view/download outputs for its institution; R&R full workspace
destinations.Eligibility_Rule: Use approved facts and assets; channel adaptation may be generated as draft
destinations.Safety_or_Quality_Control: Human approval and rights check before publication

destinations.What_Goes_Here: Email, WhatsApp and other outreach drafts, audiences, recipient lists and delivery logs
destinations.Visibility_Default: University can view/download its permitted campaign outputs; R&R full workspace
destinations.Eligibility_Rule: Purpose, audience, consent/lawful basis, contact validity and approval required
destinations.Safety_or_Quality_Control: Generation does not mean sending; connected service and authorization required

destinations.Visibility_Default: Rafts and Rivers internal by default; shareable deliverables may be released
destinations.Eligibility_Rule: Defined denominator, time period, completeness and methodology
destinations.Safety_or_Quality_Control: No unsupported causal claims; privacy thresholds for small groups

destinations.Visibility_Default: Rafts and Rivers internal by default; approved deliverables may be released
destinations.Eligibility_Rule: Explicit indicator definitions, source evidence and scope
destinations.Safety_or_Quality_Control: No SDG impact claim from keyword alone

destinations.What_Goes_Here: Employers, recruiter contacts, placement records, internships, offers, MoUs
destinations.Visibility_Default: Rafts and Rivers full workspace; university-visible contact/placement outputs by policy
destinations.Eligibility_Rule: Entity resolution, period, contact provenance and permissions
destinations.Safety_or_Quality_Control: Personal contact data and employer confidentiality

destinations.What_Goes_Here: Custom reports, queries, extracts and bespoke output packages
destinations.Visibility_Default: Rafts and Rivers internal by default; explicit release required
destinations.Eligibility_Rule: Request specification, source snapshot, reproducible query/template
destinations.Safety_or_Quality_Control: Check access and privacy before export

destinations.What_Goes_Here: Duplicates, contradictions, stale values, missing provenance, validation issues
destinations.Visibility_Default: Rafts and Rivers internal; selected actionable issues may be released
destinations.Safety_or_Quality_Control: Do not overwrite conflicting source facts silently

destinations.Visibility_Default: Rafts and Rivers full workspace; audit excerpt may accompany release
destinations.Eligibility_Rule: Persist source snapshot and version metadata
